cards.name: Block Dissolve - digital

cards.duration_note: Read from the .ffx: Transition Completion keyed 0 -> 100 from comp.time +0 s to +1.0 s; it is an IN transition (layer fully visible at the last key).
cards.scripting: Set comp.time to the transition start, deselect all layers, set layer.selected = true, then layer.applyPreset(new File(<preset .ffx path>)) (applyPreset acts on every selected layer, so isolate the target first); keyframe times are relative to comp.time. Effect and control names this preset creates start with a TAB character (e.g. '\tTransition Completion'), and the rig's expressions reference those exact names: address them by match name or strip the leading tab when searching, and do not rename them. Master control ADBE CM TransDissolve has only 'Transition Completion' (ADBE CM TransDissolve-0001, keyed 0 -> 100 = layer arrives; there is no reverse checkbox). For an OUT transition, swap the two keyframe values (100 -> 0) and place them at the layer end. Expressions (read from the .ffx): Block Dissolve completion = linear 100 -> 0; Block Width = layer width/10; Block Height eases from 1 px to layer height/3; Feather 0.5.

verified.note: Footage half revealed through random black blocks at 0.5 s (thin horizontal slivers at 0.2 s in the render), fully clean at 1.4 s.

cards.duration_note: Read from the .ffx: Transition Completion keyed 0 -> 100 from comp.time +0 s to +1.0 s; it is an IN transition (layer fully visible at the last key).
cards.scripting: Set comp.time to the transition start, deselect all layers, set layer.selected = true, then layer.applyPreset(new File(<preset .ffx path>)) (applyPreset acts on every selected layer, so isolate the target first); keyframe times are relative to comp.time. Effect and control names this preset creates start with a TAB character (e.g. '\tTransition Completion'), and the rig's expressions reference those exact names: address them by match name or strip the leading tab when searching, and do not rename them. Master control ADBE CM TransStretch has only 'Transition Completion' (ADBE CM TransStretch-0001, keyed 0 -> 100 = layer arrives; there is no reverse checkbox). For an OUT transition, swap the two keyframe values (100 -> 0) and place them at the layer end. Transform effect (centred): Scale Height eases 0 -> 100, Scale Width eases 150 -> 100. Read from the expressions, not checked in a render.

verified.note: Footage squashed in height with black bars top and bottom at 0.5 s, full frame at 1.4 s.

cards.name: Zoom - 2D spin
cards.summary: The layer scales up from 0 to 100 % while rotating from -180 degrees (half a turn, set by Spin Amount) to upright, landing at full size.
use_for: Comedic / satire newspaper or photo spin-in
avoid: Cheesy on serious content
Fast spin judders at 25/30 fps
cards.duration_note: Read from the .ffx: Transition Completion keyed 0 -> 100 from comp.time +0 s to +1.0 s; it is an IN transition (layer fully visible at the last key).
cards.scripting: Set comp.time to the transition start, deselect all layers, set layer.selected = true, then layer.applyPreset(new File(<preset .ffx path>)) (applyPreset acts on every selected layer, so isolate the target first); keyframe times are relative to comp.time. Effect and control names this preset creates start with a TAB character (e.g. '\tTransition Completion'), and the rig's expressions reference those exact names: address them by match name or strip the leading tab when searching, and do not rename them. Here the master control is the pseudo effect '\tZoom - 2D spin' (ADBE CM Zoom2DSpin): 'Transition Completion' (-0001, keyed 0 -> 100 = layer arrives) and 'Spin Amount' (-0002, 180 degrees; the layer starts rotated by minus this). No reverse checkbox. A Transform effect (centred) does uniform Scale 0 -> 100 and the rotation, both linear. For an OUT transition, swap the two keyframe values and place them at the layer end.

verified.note: Footage at about 70 % scale rotated well past 90 degrees at 0.5 s, upright and full size at 1.4 s.
